items.title: Crypto firms urge SEC to speed ETF reviews and allow confidential draft filings
items.summary: In contrast, Jane Street and Charles Schwab raised concerns over rushed ETF launches and confidential filings limiting market scrutiny.

items.title: IMF confirms El Salvador’s bitcoin growth was funded by private donations, not public money
items.summary: The IMF confirmed that all bitcoin added to official holdings since June 2025 was sourced from private donations, with no public funds used for accumulation.

items.title: US bitcoin ETFs report the largest inflow day since January, worth $731 million
items.summary: Analysts attributed Fed Governor Christopher Waller’s dovish comments to the significant inflow of capital into bitcoin products.

items.title: Bitcoin ETF inflows hit $731M, highest since January as BTC reclaims $80K
items.summary: US Bitcoin ETFs drew $730.9 million on Thursday as Bitcoin reclaimed $80,000, though CryptoQuant flagged weak fresh demand and a key $83,000 test.
